digest.component_or_area: live Jira DC test harness — store-copy isolation fixture
propositions: .bridge_state artifacts survive the store-copy scrub in test_the_store_copy_is_complete_and_scrubbed, causing test failure on origin/main

The projects-seed ensure unit (added in commit 72731d3745) unconditionally re-creates .bridge_state/projects.json when run_ensures converges the copied store, resurrecting an artifact the prior scrub removed
The scrub executes before run_ensures, but the ensure unit's tree-check misses and commits the resurrected file, leaving .bridge_state* in both worktree and tickets tree
Re-running the scrub (with commit) after run_ensures removes the resurrected .bridge_state/* while preserving the .env-id store marker created by convergence
A fast unit regression test (TestBridgeStateScrub in test_dc_store_copy_fetch_diagnostics.py) reproduces the resurrection and validates the post-converge scrub fix without invoking the live harness
